# DIRECTION — 02-atelier-printworks

## Design thesis
Atelier Møn Printworks is not a generic marketing template: first fold must make “enquire about a print edition.” inevitable via single object left, large type right. Focus objects: letterpress posters, map editions, shop bags for island shops.

## Subject grounding
Subject: Atelier Møn Printworks
Audience: curators and small brands commissioning limited runs.
Primary action: enquire about a print edition.
Products/work: letterpress posters, map editions, shop bags for island shops
Brand palette cues: chalk white, harbour ink, coral registration mark
Anti-references: generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos; generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos.

## Hierarchy
1) named work/edition 2) process/material proof 3) enquire about a print edition. 4) secondary pieces — no award theater

## Signature
atelier-møn-edition-mark

## Primary risk
Must not drift into banned tropes (generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos; generic creative-agen); signature may overfit if evidence is thin.

## Axis record

- direction-version: 2.3
- composition: single object left, large type right
- type: condensed display grotesque over quiet sans
- colour: chalk white, harbour ink, coral registration mark — brand evidence only; single reserved accent
- imagery: diagram-led or edition-sheet slots until declared plates exist; no invented photography
- rhythm: hard vertical split then calm bands

- surface: open — subject earns space around the object
- labels: sentence case captions — retail voice stays human
- figures: proportional — price is content not motif
- depth: elevated — object lifts off ground slightly

- visual-density: 4
- motion-intensity: 3
- aesthetic-boldness: 7

- signature-selector: [data-signature="atelier-møn-edition-mark"]
- signature-min-share: 12

## Implementation notes

Do not invent testimonials, prices, awards, or assets not in the evidence pack.
Build context must not receive losing cards or generator scores.
